page: OVHcloud c2-60 is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel x86_64 processor running at 3.0 GHz. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The hardware configuration includes 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core, alongside a local 400 GB SSD for storage. Network connectivity is supported by a 1 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data places the c2-60 in the average performance tier for most multi-core and memory operations. The instance achieved a multi-core Geekbench score of 8158.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 24191.73. Single-core performance is relatively weaker, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1093.0. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only large block speed of 120.4 GB/sec and a write speed of 45.09 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, it handles static web serving at 16.25 GB/sec and processes Redis SET operations at 25.27 million operations per second.

Due to the older Intel Haswell architecture and lack of AVX-512 support, the server is less suited for modern heavy vector math or large-scale LLM text generation, where it registers weak to poor performance. However, the dedicated physical cores and balanced memory allocation make it highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring stable, non-burstable CPU performance. It is well-suited for software compilation, static web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
